infrastructure and security-critical systems. 3+ years shipping production

Engineering (Cyber Security) at the University of Oulu.

- Spoken languages: English (fluent, C1/C2), Finnish (beginner, A1).

## Experience

- Research Intern, University of Oulu (Jun 2026 to Aug 2026). Extended the
  AVISE AI security evaluation framework to Text-to-Image models with a
  16-case adversarial test suite; co-authored a paper submitted to NordSec
  2026.
- Full Stack Software Engineer, Datapulse Technologies, Ireland, remote
  (Feb 2024 to Mar 2026). Rebuilt a multi-region whitelabel payment gateway
  now serving 1000+ merchants; 25% performance gain; integrated three
  acquirers plus Apple Pay and Google Pay; owned CI/CD; led PCI-DSS
  readiness, closing 15+ audit findings; substitute team lead.
- Trainee Engineer (part-time), Rapidev, Islamabad (Jul 2022 to May 2024).
  RapiGuard anti-UAV sensor integration, key management application with
  UART key injection for radio hardware, Flutter situational-awareness app.
- Software Engineering Intern, Bitnine, remote (Mar 2023 to Aug 2023).
  Apache AGE contributor; built the AG Cloud website.
